title: November 11 — V27 implemented, V28 native reader, Tunnistus benchmark, SihtiSR super-resolution
summary: Corrects an early-November-11 snapshot when V27 contained only a proposal, but does not duplicate V27's existing node. The later V27 work shows real native event-ring storage and selective erase. V28 reads sparse-ring windows with a second native autonomous clock. Tunnistus measures one interrupted instruction-blinded mutated-box investigation. SihtiSR revisits existing RAISR-like structure-sorted super-resolution; Moon remains in its earlier pass.

nodes.claim: A native ~59-tick original oscillator drives a hand-wired coincidence reader attached to a 32-tick eight-relay V27 circulating memory.
nodes.survived: Source: 1,917/1,917 correct two-tick OR-window reads over 27 sparse/empty patterns, 27/27 rings retained, 32/32 sampled start phases; clock-only/ring-only ablations silent.
nodes.killed: Dense all-ones rings corrupt (55/71 correct); operator-timed one-bit reads 190/192; two-tick OR does not distinguish arbitrary adjacent bits. No trained weights or biologically validated memory.
nodes.era: November 11: delayed memory, native reader, blind archaeology and Sihti residue

nodes.claim: Blind Machine Archaeologist benchmark: an instruction-blinded Fable subject inspects a renamed documented Perception Lab loop and an altered black-box machine; two runs were stopped early.
nodes.survived: Beta subject committed 4/4 correct hidden parameter/port changes, 19/19 live/dead results, 8/8 unseen change predictions, and passed native clock and 40-bit ring-memory gates; brute-force baseline did not find memory. Resolution sweep retained approximately 59-tick rhythm.
nodes.killed: Alpha run committed no gates and scores zero; beta reader gate not attempted. One interrupted trial and one mutated box; documented rules supplied, subject shares model family, blindness only by instructions.
nodes.era: November 11: delayed memory, native reader, blind archaeology and Sihti residue

nodes.claim: Small ×2 grayscale super-resolution model: 216 edge-angle/strength/coherence buckets, each fitted with a 25-to-4 ridge-regression map and mean-preserving output lock.
nodes.survived: Source-reported BSDS500 200-image held-out PSNR: 29.45 dB versus bicubic 28.56, Lanczos 28.81 and single filter 29.09; 21,600 solved parameters, browser and Python output agree.
nodes.killed: Reimplements known RAISR-like structure-bucket super-resolution rather than new method. Lock adds no measured PSNR. Evaluation assumes 2×2 mean downsample and does not establish performance on real JPEG/camera or current deep SR.
nodes.era: November 11: delayed memory, native reader, blind archaeology and Sihti residue

edges.why: V27 preserves the native V26 silent relay and existing setpoint port and adds fixed delay/attenuation wires.
V28 retains V27's core and ring but adds a second original clocked neuron driving a native coincidence readout.
Tunnistus repackages and secretly alters the documented Perception Lab/origin-review loop for an AI black-box audit.
Both arise from Sihti coarse/fine visual-residue inquiry; SihtiSR's RAISR-like filter does not claim direct inherited SihtiSilma code.

motifs.title: Stored event patterns become readable by another native clock
motifs.description: V27 recirculates and selectively erases events; V28's separately self-oscillating original unit reads two-tick windows through native coincidence. Sparse patterns succeeded; dense/all-one and precise single-tick readouts are bounded failures, not unlimited memory.

motifs.title: A benchmark may succeed while its architecture is already familiar
motifs.description: Tunnistus's committed mutated-box gates are a single interrupted blind trial; SihtiSR's concrete held-out PSNR gain uses the known RAISR family, not a new SR principle.
